title: Planned NBN maintenance – Thornbury POI (3TNB), VIC
current_summary: Planned work at the NBN Thornbury POI (3TNB) is scheduled for Wednesday 7 October 2026 between 12:00am and 3:00am AEDT. NBN services delivered via this POI may experience interruptions during the window.

updates.content:
We will be performing planned maintenance at the NBN Thornbury POI (3TNB) on Wednesday 7 October 2026 between 12:00am and 3:00am AEDT. Services delivered via this POI may be interrupted during the window (up to 3 hours).

What this means for you:
- Scope: NBN services connected at the Thornbury POI (3TNB), VIC.
- Impact: Short interruptions are expected during the maintenance window.
- No action is required. If your service does not restore after 3:00am AEDT, please power cycle your modem/router and contact our support team.

We will monitor the work and confirm once complete.
